errors.evidence: The y-axis has no label specifying units. The description hallucinates that the unit is percentage (%).

errors.text_span: 对于HWER-Dov类别，蓝色柱状图高度约为-0.5
errors.evidence: In the HWER-Dov category, the blue bar is very close to zero, at approximately -0.1 or -0.2. A value of -0.5 is a significant misreading of the chart, as it would be a quarter of the way to the -2 tick mark.
